questions.q: How does permutation importance measure a feature's importance?
options: It counts how many times the feature is used in tree splits
It removes the feature and retrains the model from scratch on the training data
It shuffles the feature's values on held-out data and measures how much the model's score drops
It correlates the feature with the target
questions.explain: Shuffling breaks the feature's relationship with the target; the drop in score shows how much the model relies on it.

questions.q: In the lesson, the random_noise column got an impurity importance of 0.187. What does this show?
options: Built-in impurity importance can rank a useless feature highly because it is measured on training data and favors features with many split points
The noise column secretly predicts churn
Random forests cannot be used for churn
Permutation importance is broken
questions.explain: Impurity importance reflects how much a feature was used to split training data, so a continuous noise column can look important. Permutation importance on the test set gave it about zero.

questions.q: Two features carry nearly identical information. What is likely to happen to their permutation importances?
options: Both will be exactly double what they should be
Each may look small because when one is shuffled the model can lean on the other
Both will be exactly zero in every case
Nothing; correlation never affects importance
questions.explain: Correlated features share credit. Shuffling one still leaves the other, so the score barely drops. Group or drop redundant features before interpreting.

questions.q: Why compute permutation importance on the test set rather than the training set?
options: The test set is always larger
scikit-learn refuses to run on training data
It is faster
Training-set importance can reward features the model merely memorized, while held-out data reflects real signal
questions.explain: A model can overfit to noise in the training data. Measuring the score drop on unseen data shows what it truly relies on.

questions.q: Which statement about importance scores is correct?
options: They describe what the model relies on, not whether changing a feature would change the real-world outcome
A feature with high importance is proven to cause churn
Importance scores are identical across all model types
A negative permutation importance close to zero means a very important feature
questions.explain: Importance explains model behavior, not causation. A value near zero, even slightly negative, means shuffling the feature did not hurt the score.
